summary: Verified full-width admin panel layout fix. Logged in via /login as admin@antrian.id, iterated all 9 admin tabs (dashboard, branches, services, counters, recap, settings, users, database, printers) at 1920x800 viewport. Content bounding box width = 1584px for every tab (>1331px threshold = 80% of 1664px content area). No console/page errors. Header controls remain right-aligned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login route is /login (not /admin/login). All admin tab content containers render at 1584px width on 1920 viewport with 256px sidebar. Fix (removing max-w-* wrappers in Admin.jsx) is effective across all tabs.
rca of the issue: Previously max-w-6xl on <main> and max-w-3xl/5xl/6xl on Database/Printers/Aplikasi wrappers constrained content to ~1152px, leaving ~30% right-side gap. Removing these classes restored full width to 1584px.
